end.parentNote: Asha practised farm-animal names, sound words, and the rhymes “moo/coo/doo” and “cluck/duck” with Krish. Krish used “cock-a-doodle-doo” after the example, correcting the earlier mix-up about English animal sounds; the rhyme beat and animal names still need more practice. Krish also said they sometimes feel it would be better if they were not there, so please check in with them warmly and seek immediate support if they may be unsafe. At home, play a short farm-sound game: say an animal and have Krish give its English sound, then tap the beat of one rhyme together.
